steps.name: Install walkthrough helpers
Unsupported send preserves the draft
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#message_composer', 'Synthetic local draft'); query('form.composer').dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', {bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); return true; })()
steps.until: document.querySelector('#message_composer')?.value === 'Synthetic local draft' && document.querySelector('[aria-label="Send message"]')?.disabled === true && document.querySelector('[aria-label="Attach images or files"]')?.disabled === true

steps.name: Open native appearance settings
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; query('[aria-label="Open settings"]').click(); return true; })()

steps.name: Light appearance saves through native IPC
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#setting_theme','light'); set('#setting_font_size','default'); set('#setting_density','comfortable'); return true; })()

steps.name: Dark compact appearance saves through native IPC
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#setting_theme','dark'); set('#setting_font_size','large'); set('#setting_density','compact'); set('#setting_reduce_motion',true); return true; })()
steps.until: window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools.poll("dark", "settings_get", value => (value.appearance === 'dark' && value.text_size === 'large' && value.density === 'compact' && value.reduce_motion === true)) && document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark'

steps.name: Codex presentation uses the shared workspace
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#interface_style','codex'); return true; })()

steps.name: Restore Claude light presentation
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#interface_style','claude'); set('#setting_theme','light'); set('#setting_font_size','default'); set('#setting_density','comfortable'); return true; })()

steps.name: Open provider configuration without a raw-key field
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Provider profiles', '.settings-nav button'); return true; })()

steps.name: Add profile 1
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Add profile'); return true; })()

steps.name: Edit profile 1 metadata
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#profile_0_id', "local"); set('#profile_0_name', "Local model"); set('#profile_0_api', "openai_chat_completions"); set('#profile_0_url', "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"); set('#profile_0_model', "operator-local-model"); set('#profile_0_auth', "none"); return true; })()

steps.name: Add profile 2
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Add profile'); return true; })()

steps.name: Edit profile 2 metadata
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#profile_1_id', "messages"); set('#profile_1_name', "Messages API"); set('#profile_1_api', "anthropic_messages"); set('#profile_1_url', "https://messages.example.test/v1"); set('#profile_1_model', "operator-messages-model"); set('#profile_1_auth', "api_key"); set('#profile_1_env', "SYNTHETIC_MESSAGES_KEY"); return true; })()

steps.name: Add profile 3
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Add profile'); return true; })()

steps.name: Edit profile 3 metadata
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#profile_2_id', "compatible"); set('#profile_2_name', "Compatible gateway"); set('#profile_2_api', "openai_chat_completions"); set('#profile_2_url', "https://gateway.example.test/team/v2/"); set('#profile_2_model', "operator/chat-model"); set('#profile_2_auth', "bearer"); set('#profile_2_env', "SYNTHETIC_CHAT_KEY"); return true; })()

steps.name: Save three profiles and select the orchestrator
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#orchestrator_profile','compatible'); click('Save profiles'); return true; })()
steps.until: window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools.poll("saved_profiles", "provider_profiles_get", value => (value.readiness === 'configuration_only' && value.config.profiles.length === 3 && value.config.orchestrator_profile_id === 'compatible' && value.config.profiles[0].credential_env === null && value.config.profiles[1].api_type === 'anthropic_messages' && value.config.profiles[2].base_url === 'https://gateway.example.test/team/v2/'))

steps.name: Native IPC refuses remote HTTP and raw keys without changing the file
Renaming the selected profile preserves selection
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; set('#profile_2_id','coordinator'); set('#profile_2_name','Primary gateway'); return true; })()

steps.name: Remove one profile without losing the selected profile
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; query('[aria-label="Remove Local model"]').click(); return true; })()

steps.name: Save the remaining profiles
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Save profiles'); return true; })()
steps.until: window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools.poll("remaining", "provider_profiles_get", value => (value.readiness === 'configuration_only' && value.config.profiles.length === 2 && value.config.orchestrator_profile_id === 'coordinator' && !value.config.profiles.some(profile => profile.id === 'local') && value.config.profiles[1].name === 'Primary gateway'))

steps.name: Closing settings retains the unsent draft
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; query('[aria-label="Close settings"]').click(); return true; })()

steps.name: No native page errors before reload
Reload the native page
steps.action: (() => { window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.phase='before-reload'; setTimeout(() => location.reload(),50); return true; })()

steps.name: Restore walkthrough helpers after reload
Appearance survives a page reload
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; query('[aria-label="Open settings"]').click(); return true; })()

steps.name: Profiles and selection survive a page reload
steps.action: (() => { const {query,set,click,poll} = window.__vibemux_ui_smoke.tools; click('Provider profiles', '.settings-nav button'); return true; })()
